subject: Error when trying to predict logistic regression

messages.author: 6c27402f264740f4
messages.subject: Error when trying to predict logistic regression
parts:
I am trying to do a logistic regression but I keep on getting an error that I can not seem to fix. I have looked at many other people having this problem but none of the fixes they used seems to help. 

This is the error:

file: smtp-taucs.c  hgid: 29c6a7f1b1ff  date: Thu Jun 15 19:50:23 2017 +0800
Function: GMRFLib_factorise_sparse_matrix_TAUCS(), Line: 829, Thread: 0
Fail to factorize Q. I will try to fix it...


Code:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(124)

ss <- sample(1:4, size = nrow(df1), replace=TRUE, prob = c(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25))

t1 <- df1[ss==1,]
t2 <- df1[ss==2,]
t3 <- df1[ss==3,]
t4 <- df1[ss==4,]


kick <- zeroFac ~ goal + Twords + City_Pop + Length_of_kick +
  Days_spent_making_campign  + Categories + County + 
  f(state_codes, model = "bym", graph = USA.adj) +
  f(year, model = "rw2") +
  f(year1, model = "iid") +
  f(state_codes1, model = "besag" , graph = USA.adj,
    group = year2, 
    control.group = list(model = "rw2"))

t22 <- t2
t22$zeroFac <- NA
t12 <- rbind(t22,t1)

mod.climb <- inla(kick, data = t12, family = "binomial", 
                  Ntrials = 1, 
                  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
                  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
                  control.inla = list(cmin = 0), 
                  verbose = TRUE)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error when trying to predict logistic regression
parts:
if this error occour a few times, its ok, if it occurs all the time,
its a problem. with so many intrinsic model componenent, its likely
that increasing the diagonal value added, will resolve it. default
value is

> INLA:::inla.set.f.default()$diagonal
[1] 1.015113099e-05


try adding

diagonal=1e-4


to model rw2, bym, besag


thx
H
